sidebar.emptyDescription: Your first Skill testing workbench will appear here after it is created.

hero.title: Create a Skill testing workbench
hero.description: A workbench binds one Skill source, test definitions, runtime configuration, execution traces, and artifacts into a locally managed project.

setup.title: Workbench initialization
setup.description: Create a testing workbench in four steps. The completed project will appear in the list on the left.

name.title: Name the workbench
name.description: Give the Skill testing project a clear name so it is easy to identify in the project list.

source.title: Import Skill source
source.description: Choose a local Skill folder or import a ZIP archive containing the complete Skill files.

runtime.title: Configure runtime
runtime.description: Enter a user-managed Endpoint URL, API Key, and Model ID for a compatible inference service.

validate.title: Validate and enter
validate.description: Check the Skill structure and runtime connection, then enter the project to begin testing.

localFirst.title: Local-first design
localFirst.description: Skill files and test data stay on this computer. The frontend does not upload project data directly.

createDialog.title: Create testing workbench
createDialog.workbenchNamePlaceholder: For example: Invoice Review Skill Workbench
createDialog.workbenchNameHelp: This name appears in the project list on the left.
createDialog.folderDescription: Choose a local folder containing the Skill files.
createDialog.zipDescription: Import a ZIP archive containing the complete Skill.
createDialog.dropHint: Click to browse or drop the source here.
createDialog.sourceRequired: Choose a Skill folder or ZIP archive.

settingsDialog.title: Default runtime
settingsDialog.description: Configure only the Endpoint URL, API Key, and Model ID used by new projects.

detail.placeholder: The project detail page will be designed separately. This screen only preserves the navigation boundary from the project list.
